{{Quote|What do you expect? You ask your men to starve while you eat bantha steaks from offworld?|Kahrin Wek|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Bantha steak''' also known as '''bantha beef''' was the edible meat of a [[Bantha/Legends|bantha]] and a type of [[Steak/Legends|steak]]. It was served at [[Jun Seros (Whiphid)|Jun Seros]]' diner in [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], and on [[Arbra/Legends|Arbra]]. It was often made into a [[Bantha Steak Soup|soup]].
